title: Somebody came up
notes: The eleven, as they come up (COMMS.md 6.2)
Distress calls carry random names, so a rescue is not a roster. What she
can do is say the name back -- which is the thing a counter never does.

lines.text: It's Shepard. %2 is aboard. In quarantine, but aboard.
Thin. Filthy. Asked for coffee before a blanket.
The Doctor says that's a good sign. I think he's lying.

options.text: Tell them they owe me one.

lines.text: I'll tell them. Thank you. Really. Shepard out.
